UserObject.mermaidData:
{
  "data": "sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor C as Customer
    participant FE as Frontend
    participant MW as Auth Middleware
    participant LCtrl as LocationController
    participant LSvc as LocationService
    participant ISvc as ImageService
    participant Storage as Supabase Storage
    participant LRepo as LocationRepository
    participant LRRepo as LocationRequestRepository
    participant N as Notification Service

    C->>FE: Open "Contribute Location" form
    C->>FE: Enter details, pin location, select images/videos

    %% --- SUBMIT LOCATION WITH MEDIA FILES ---
    FE->>MW: POST /api/v1/locations (data + images/videos)
    activate MW

    MW->>MW: Authenticate JWT
    MW->>MW: Check trustLevel != RESTRICTED
    MW->>MW: Check submit quota
    MW->>LCtrl: Forward request
    deactivate MW

    activate LCtrl
    LCtrl->>LSvc: contributeLocation(customerId, data, mediaFiles)
    activate LSvc

    %% --- VALIDATE DATA AND BUSINESS RULES FIRST ---
    LSvc->>LSvc: Validate required fields
    LSvc->>LSvc: Validate category/subcategory/tags
    LSvc->>LSvc: Validate geo scope
    LSvc->>LSvc: Check location accuracy
    LSvc->>LSvc: Calculate pin-device distance
    LSvc->>LSvc: Validate media metadata

    LSvc->>LRepo: findNearbyLocations(coordinates)
    activate LRepo
    LRepo-->>LSvc: Return nearby locations
    deactivate LRepo

    LSvc->>LSvc: Detect suspected duplicate

    alt Invalid data or business rule failed
        LSvc-->>LCtrl: Validation error
        deactivate LSvc
        LCtrl-->>FE: 400 Bad Request
        deactivate LCtrl
        FE-->>C: Show validation error

    else Validation passed
        %% --- UPLOAD MEDIA AFTER VALIDATION ---
        LSvc->>ISvc: uploadLocationMedia(mediaFiles)
        activate ISvc

        ISvc->>ISvc: Validate actual file size, MIME type, extension
        ISvc->>Storage: Upload images/videos
        activate Storage
        Storage-->>ISvc: Return public URLs
        deactivate Storage

        ISvc-->>LSvc: Return uploadedMediaUrls
        deactivate ISvc

        %% --- SAVE LOCATION AND REQUEST TO DATABASE ---
        LSvc->>LRepo: createLocation(data + uploadedMediaUrls, status: SUBMITTED, ownerId: null, source: CUSTOMER)
        activate LRepo
        LRepo-->>LSvc: Return new locationId
        deactivate LRepo

        LSvc->>LRRepo: createLocationRequest(locationId, customerId, submittedDataSnapshot, uploadedMediaUrls)
        activate LRRepo
        LRRepo-->>LSvc: Return new requestId
        deactivate LRRepo

        LSvc->>N: notify(customerId, "Submission is pending approval")
        activate N
        N-->>LSvc: Notification created
        deactivate N

        LSvc-->>LCtrl: Return success result
        deactivate LSvc

        LCtrl-->>FE: 201 Created
        deactivate LCtrl

        FE-->>C: Show "Submitted successfully, waiting for approval"
    end

    Note over LSvc,LRRepo: Location is saved as SUBMITTED. LocationRequest stores the create-location review record.",
  "config": null
}
